candidate_relations.reason: Moderately active colitis with cryptitis and crypt abscesses is a histological descriptor and IBD is a broad parent category; neither captures the specific starvation/hunger-strike etiology required by the benchmark diagnosis of starvation colitis.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Describes histopathological findings and a broad IBD category without attributing etiology to starvation/hunger strike

candidate_relations.reason: Ulcerative Colitis is a chronic idiopathic inflammatory condition; attributing the presentation to UC conflicts with the benchmark's starvation-related etiology, even though the endoscopic and histological features overlap. The clinical context (hunger strike, resolution on refeeding) points away from UC.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Asserts a specific IBD subtype (Ulcerative Colitis) with an incompatible etiology, displacing the starvation cause

candidate_relations.reason: Hunger strike-associated colitis on day 33 of an organized hunger strike is a direct alias for starvation colitis; it captures the same etiological entity (colitis caused by prolonged food deprivation) with all required components present.
candidate_relations.scope_detail: Names the hunger-strike/starvation context explicitly, equivalent to starvation colitis

case_quality_flags: Starvation colitis is a rare diagnosis; histological and endoscopic features mimic IBD, making etiology (hunger strike context) the critical differentiating element.
